brief.zh: 先观察参考框，再把覆盖整张照片的框收紧，减少多余背景。
brief.en: Look at the reference box, then tighten the full-image box to remove extra background.

concept.zh: 在保留目标的同时，缩去多余背景会提高交并比。
concept.en: Trimming extra background while keeping the object raises IoU.

hints.zh: 狗接近照片下方。先对齐框的上边和左边，再收右边。
hints.en: The dog is near the bottom. Align the top and left edges first, then bring in the right edge.

prompt.zh: 让你的框和狗的参考框交并比达到 82%。
prompt.en: Make your box reach at least 82% IoU with the dog's reference box.
